svg.aria-label: Master architecture of java-payment-service: a hexagonal Spring Boot payment service with REST, Kafka and scheduled drivers on the left, an application core with use cases and a framework-free domain in the centre, secondary adapters on the right talking to PostgreSQL, Kafka, Apicurio Registry, the bank's external account, authorization, limit and payment systems and merchant webhook endpoints, with the observability stack and the delivery pipeline below.
